# Do Your MBA in Dubai

Hult's ultra-modern Dubai campus is surrounded by world-leading tech companies
and encapsulates the city's highly driven nothing-is-impossible attitude.

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)VIRTUAL
TOUR![hult-dubai-virtual-
tour](https://img2.storyblok.com/f/45434/1200x800/973ebd194e/hult-dubai-
virtual-tour.jpg)

Hult Dubai’s cutting-edge design reflects its location in Dubai’s Internet
City, just as the student community mirrors the city’s ambitious, supportive,
and multicultural workforce.

Key highlights

  * Modern and minimalist interiors

  * Flexible classrooms and collaborative working spaces

  * Multifaith worship spaces

  * In innovation hub, Internet City, surrounded by services and corporate headquarters

  * Walking distance from the Metro and minutes from the beach

  * Close to Dubai Marina well connected to the city's renowned leisure venues

TEDxHultDubai

TEDx is an international community that organizes TED-style events celebrating
locally-driven ideas. This student club brings this organization to the Hult
Dubai community.

Doing Business in Africa

This student club runs networking events and hosts experienced speakers who
share their journey, experience, advice, and the latest trends in Africa.

Alumni panels

Hult alums in the Dubai area regularly come to campus to meet current
students, share their journey after Hult, and give their future fellow alumni
the benefit of their experience.
